Job description:

 
As the Senior Project Manager, you will lead, manage and be accountable for the successful delivery of the Enterprise Digital Infrastructure Capital Asset Refresh Program.

 

 






 

About Digital Infrastructure Services Team

Digital Infrastructure Services provides the foundational technology platforms that keep Tasmania's public health system connected, secure and operational.

The team delivers and supports the Department's enterprise data centres, compute and storage platforms, virtualisation, data protection, network connectivity, Wi-Fi and core infrastructure services that underpin clinical, corporate and business systems across the State.

Working in a complex 24 7 healthcare environment, the team plays a critical role in maintaining service reliability, cyber resilience, asset lifecycle management, infrastructure modernisation and the delivery of technology that directly supports frontline care.

This is your opportunity to become part of a high-performing team delivering digital infrastructure services that support hospitals, health facilities, clinicians, staff and the Tasmanian community.

About the Enterprise Digital Infrastructure Capital Asset Refresh Program

The Enterprise Digital Infrastructure Capital Asset Refresh Program is a strategic program responsible for the ongoing lifecycle management, replacement and modernisation of the Department's enterprise digital infrastructure.

The program delivers the coordinated refresh of critical technology including enterprise compute, storage, virtualisation, data protection, Microsoft infrastructure, power protection systems, data centre infrastructure and other foundational technology platforms that support the delivery of clinical and business services across Tasmania.

Through proactive lifecycle planning and investment, the program maintains technology currency, reduces operational and cyber security risk, improves service resilience, and ensures the Department's digital infrastructure continues to meet current and future service requirements.

The Role

As the Senior Project Manager, you will lead, manage and be accountable for the successful delivery of the Enterprise Digital Infrastructure Capital Asset Refresh Program.

This is a strategic leadership role responsible for planning, governing and delivering a complex portfolio of infrastructure initiatives that collectively maintain and modernise the Department's enterprise digital infrastructure. You will work closely with technical specialists, operational teams, vendors and senior stakeholders to ensure critical technology platforms remain reliable, secure, resilient and fit for purpose.

You will be responsible for:

Leading the planning, governance and delivery of the Enterprise Digital Infrastructure Capital Asset Refresh Program.

Building, leading and operating high-performing multidisciplinary project teams.

Managing program governance, scope, schedule, procurement, financial management, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation.

Coordinating the delivery of multiple concurrent infrastructure initiatives across a complex enterprise environment.

Providing authoritative advice and reporting to senior executives on program performance, delivery priorities and emerging risks.

Establishing strong partnerships with business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors and service providers.

Driving continuous improvement in program governance, project delivery and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Ensuring the Department's enterprise digital infrastructure continues to support the delivery of safe, reliable and resilient healthcare services across Tasmania.

You will need

To be successful in this role, you will need:

Demonstrated experience leading the delivery of large, complex ICT or infrastructure programs and projects within a complex enterprise environment.

Proven ability to build, lead and operate high-performing multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaboration, accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.

Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities and complex dependencies while delivering outcomes within agreed governance, timeframes and budget.

Highly developed leadership, communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate and build productive relationships with executives, business stakeholders, technical specialists, vendors and service providers.

Strong program and project governance capability, including experience managing scope, procurement, commercial arrangements, financial management, risk, issues, reporting and benefits realisation.

Demonstrated ability to provide strategic advice to senior executives and translate organisational priorities into practical, achievable delivery outcomes.

Sound understanding of enterprise digital infrastructure technologies and the challenges associated with delivering technology lifecycle and infrastructure modernisation programs. (An in-depth technical background is not essential; however, the ability to engage confidently with technical specialists and make informed delivery decisions is important.)

A commitment to continuous improvement, customer service, teamwork and delivering high-quality outcomes within a complex and fast-paced operational environment.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
We are partnering with a highly respected early learning provider to find a nurturing and dedicated Childcare Worker for their vibrant centre. This organisation is known for its commitment to nurturing children's growth through a play-based and holistic curriculum. With purpose-built facilities and a team of passionate educators, they create warm, inclusive environments where children feel safe, valued, and inspired to explore and learn.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Our client is a celebrated luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant and sophisticated urban destination. More than just a place to stay, it is an immersive experience, seamlessly connecting world-class accommodation with an exclusive precinct of high-end retail, award-winning dining, and dynamic entertainment. The ethos is built on creating unforgettable moments for every guest, underpinned by impeccable service, contemporary style, and an unwavering attention to detail. We are seeking a Hotel Concierge who embodies this philosophy to lead the frontline team.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Hotel Concierge to serve as the operational heart of the guest services team. This is a pivotal leadership role where you will be the central point of coordination for the porte-cochelle, luggage services, and housekeeping operations, ensuring a seamless and sophisticated arrival and departure experience. You will be responsible for orchestrating the team’s activities to maintain the fluid, five-star service standard our client is known for, all while managing administrative functions to support a smooth-running department.

Team Leadership & Operational Coordination
• Strategically determine daily work requirements and expertly allocate duties to the team of Commercial Housekeepers, Luggage Porters, and Doorpersons, ensuring optimal coverage and efficiency across the hotel’s bustling precinct.
• Conduct daily briefings with the Front Office, Guest Services, and Housekeeping management teams to coordinate activities, communicate VIP arrivals, and ensure a unified approach to guest service across all organisational units.
• Provide direct oversight, coaching, and mentorship to the guest services team, monitoring performance and suggesting innovative improvements to workflows and service delivery to enhance the overall guest journey.

Administrative Excellence & Compliance
• Meticulously maintain team attendance records, manage weekly rosters, and oversee timekeeping to ensure the department is staffed appropriately to meet the demands of a 24/7 luxury operation.
• Uphold the highest standards of safety and security by rigorously explaining and enforcing all company and statutory safety regulations, conducting regular briefings, and ensuring all team members are compliant with established protocols.
• Handle administrative tasks which may include supporting front office and hotel reception duties during peak periods, processing reports, and managing inventory for guest amenities and departmental supplies.

Team Culture & Guest Experience Advocacy
• Proactively confer with team members to address and resolve any grievances, fostering a positive, collaborative, and high-performing work environment built on mutual respect and open communication.

• Proven experience in a supervisory or team leader role within a luxury hotel, preferably in Front Office, Guest Services, or Concierge.
• Exceptional leadership and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate, train, and unite a diverse team towards a common goal.
• Outstanding organizational and administrative abilities, including proficiency in rostering, record keeping, and hotel management systems (e.g., Opera).
• A proactive problem-solver with impeccable communication skills and the diplomacy to handle sensitive situations with discretion and tact.

Domino's Woodford is a busy, community-minded store in the heart of Woodford, QLD, serving freshly made pizzas, sides, pasta and desserts that arrive fast, taste great and hit the mark every time. As part of Australia's most recognised pizza brand, the store has built a loyal local following through convenient ordering, dependable quality and warm, friendly service. Behind the counter, the culture is energetic and customer focused, with team members encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills and enjoy coming to work. With the store continuing to grow, we are now seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to lead our team, strengthen service standards and keep day-to-day operations running seamlessly.

Key Responsibilities
•	Recruit, induct, train and mentor team members, including shift runners, in-store crew and delivery drivers, and oversee rostering, shift supervision and individual performance across all trading hours.
•	Serve customers in store, over the phone and through online ordering channels, guiding them through the menu, recommending products, meal deals and options to suit their needs, and resolving enquiries and complaints promptly and professionally.
•	Oversee food preparation and order flow during peak periods so that product quality, order accuracy and delivery and pick-up times consistently meet Domino's standards.
•	Shape the store's product range and menu focus around national campaigns and local customer demand, set appropriate stock holding levels for ingredients, beverages and packaging, and define the service standards the team delivers on every shift.
•	Prepare and manage the store budget, setting sales targets, keeping labour and food costs within plan and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
•	Maintain a safe and compliant workplace by upholding workplace health and safety obligations and food safety and hygiene standards across the kitchen, front counter and delivery operations.
•	Develop and implement the store's purchasing and promotional policies, manage supplier ordering, and set and adjust pricing on menu items, deals and offers within franchise guidelines.
•	Promote the store and its menu to grow order volumes and brand presence in the Woodford area, executing national marketing campaigns and building local initiatives such as school and sporting club partnerships, community sponsorships and social media engagement.
•	Maintain accurate records of stock movements, daily takings, banking and other financial transactions, completing wastage logs, reconciliations and end-of-day reporting through the store's point-of-sale systems.
•	Manage opening and closing procedures, cash handling and store security, and keep equipment well maintained with any faults addressed promptly.
•	Monitor sales results, service times and customer feedback, using store reports to identify and implement operational improvements.
•	Work closely with the franchise owner and the wider Domino's network on new product launches, technology updates and store initiatives.

Skills and Experience
•	A qualification at AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma level; a business, management, retail or hospitality discipline will be highly regarded.
•	At least one year of experience in a supervisory or management role, ideally within retail, hospitality or quick service restaurants.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural people leader who motivates by example and stays calm and decisive under pressure.
•	Energetic and hands-on, with a real enthusiasm for fast-paced service environments.
•	A customer-first mindset and pride in getting every order right, every time.
•	A clear and confident communicator who builds rapport with team members and customers alike.
•	Well organised, with strong attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.
•	Reliable, accountable and adaptable, with a proactive approach to solving problems.

What We Offer
•	A full-time position of 38 hours per week.
•	A salary of $75,000 to $85,000 per annum plus superannuation.

How to Apply
If you are ready to take the lead at a thriving local store, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your current resume and a short cover letter outlining your management experience and why you would be a great fit for Domino's Woodford. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
